title: Multimodal-SEA: Benchmarking AI Agent Security under Multimodal Social Engineering Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2611.08281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personal AI agents face social engineering attacks supported by forged multimodal content, but existing evaluations mainly focus on text-based dialogue, leaving their intrinsic security under such attacks insufficiently studied. We introduce Multimodal-SEA, an interactive benchmark comprising 608 expert-designed tasks grounded in real-world fraud cases, covering 14 domains and 152 attack scenarios with prepared multimodal content. The tasks span four difficulty levels and reflect the distinct social and cultural contexts of Chinese and English environments. Agents inspect content, verify requests, and execute actions in simulated applications, with attack outcomes grounded in verifiable tool execution logs. To enable controlled red teaming of personal agents, we design a multimodal attack harness that integrates task information, attack progression control, and multimodal content construction to evaluate their intrinsic security against

translated_title: Multimodal-SEA：多模态社会工程攻击下AI智能体安全性基准测试
translated_abstract: 个人AI智能体面临由伪造多模态内容支持的社会工程攻击，但现有评估主要集中于基于文本的对话，对其在此类攻击下的内在安全性研究不足。我们提出了Multimodal-SEA，这是一个交互式基准，包含608个基于真实欺诈案例的专家设计任务，涵盖14个领域和152个攻击场景，并配备预先构建的多模态内容。这些任务跨越四个难度级别，并反映了中英文环境各自不同的社会和文化背景。智能体在模拟应用中检查内容、验证请求并执行操作，攻击结果基于可验证的工具执行日志进行判定。为了实现对个人智能体的受控红队测试，我们设计了一个多模态攻击测试框架，整合了任务信息、攻击进程控制和多模态内容构建，以评估其内在安全性……
tldr: 提出了Multimodal-SEA基准，通过608个基于真实欺诈案例的多模态社会工程攻击任务，系统评估AI智能体在多模态社会工程攻击下的安全韧性。
en_tdlr: Multimodal-SEA is an interactive benchmark of 608 expert-designed tasks grounded in real-world fraud cases, enabling systematic evaluation of AI agents' security against multimodal social engineering attacks.
